task_description: Full comprehensive site review and multi-agent audit
reflection_q1: Deploying parallel subagents for content sanitation and UI/SEO auditing allowed complete coverage of all 59 static routes without serial bottlenecks.
reflection_q2: Adding deep HTML integrity checks in test-routes.mjs guarantees that no unrendered Kramdown tags, empty links, or runtime errors can ever slip through to production.
reflection_q3: Structuring the test suite by domain ensured that every ontology domain index and key specification is independently validated on every build.
